description_en: Configures the logon period limits in a control policy
description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的登录时段限制配置
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-access-time-range-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 13 --access-time-range-config '{"EffectiveTime":[{"Hours":[9],"Days":[7]}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyAccessTimeRangeConfig
